claims.statement: A map of Fin n -> Q(i) sending nonzero vectors to nonzero vectors and preserving the transition probability tp x y = |<x,y>|^2/(|x|^2|y|^2) between nonzero vectors is induced on rays by a Q(i)-linear similarity F^H F = d * 1 (d > 0 rational) composed with the identity or with componentwise conjugation; no continuity hypothesis
Every map x -> c x * F (twist eps x) with F a similarity of nonzero scale preserves tp; x -> F (twist eps x) is a bijection with inverse built from (1/d) F^H, itself a similarity
tp x y equals the normalised Born readout hf (P x) y / vnorm y of the rank-one effect P x of BornHermitianCarrier; tp preservation is the preservation of this readout
|<x,y>|^2 = |x|^2 |y|^2 with x != 0 forces y into Q(i) x; tp x y = 1 iff y is a nonzero multiple of x
Every vector expands in a pairwise orthogonal family of n nonzero vectors (a left inverse of a square matrix over Q(i) is a right inverse)
A similarity with scale d > 0 is a scalar multiple of a Q(i)-unitary iff d is a sum of two rational squares
3 is not a sum of two rational squares (descent modulo 3 over Z); no Gaussian rational has norm 3
F3 = [[1,-1+i],[1+i,1]] has F3^H F3 = 3 * 1, preserves transition probabilities, and its ray map is induced by no Q(i)-unitary and by no Q(i)-antiunitary; a matrix fixing every ray is a scalar
The H006 coordinate action permute sigma is the unitary matrix permMatrix sigma, a special case of the derived class
Every ring homomorphism Q(i) -> Q(i) is the identity or conjugation
Exact replay of the probe-driven reconstruction (F, d, eps) with witnesses, induced-map verification, similarity and unitary-normalisation certificates, sums of two rational squares, countermodels
BigRational and Gaussian-rational twin with inline tests, mirroring the Python function names and witness tags
Derivation of the transition-probability (Born rank-one readout) preservation of the ray dynamics from primitive difference
Selection of a unitary (scale 1) representative for every tp-preserving ray map
A Q-parameter group of similarities through a given step
The sector carrier, the scalar field Q(i) and the quadratic shape of the readout
